Arjitha Sevas
ARJITHA SEVA DETAILS

Suprabatham
Sri Venkateswara Suprabatham, Prapathi and Mangalasasanam will be performed to Moolavarlu daily at 4.30 AM (on Friday at 3.30 AM) by the TTD Vedaparayanamdar at Ganthamandapam in Sri PAT. After completion of recitation of Suprabatham grihastha will be allowed for Darshan.
The cost of each Ticket is Rs.50/- per head.

Padmavathi Parinayam (Kalyanotsavam)
The Seva is performed to Utsava Murthies ie., Bhogasrinivasamurthy and Padmavathi Ammavaru daily at Sri Krishnaswamy Mandapam in Sri PAT from 10.00 AM to 11.00 AM. After completion of Kalyanotsavam grihastas will be allowed for Darshan.
The cost of Ticket is Rs.500/- and two persons will be allowed on each ticket.

Astadala Pada Padmaradhana seva
The seva will be performed on every Monday from 7.00 Am to 7.30 AM to Moolavarlu. One Archaka will recite Sri Padmavathi Ammavari Namavali and another Archaka will offer 108 Golden Flowers to Goddess @ One Golden flower for each Namavali and the grihastas will be seated in front of Goddess. After the sevas all the grihastas will be allowed for Darshan.
The Cost of Ticket is Rs.300/- per head.

Tiruppavada seva
The seva will be performed on every Thursday from 7.00 AM to 7.30 AM to Moolavarlu. Pulihora Prasadam specially made for this seva will be offered to Goddess at Ghantamandapam in a silver peetam(Tiruppavada Peetam). TTD Vedaparayanamdar will recite Padmavathi Ammavari Gadhyam. After that all the Grihastas will be allowed for Darshan of Goddess. Jilebi + Tenithola special Prasadam will be issued to each Ticket holders.
The Cost of ticket is Rs.1000/- per head.

Vastralankarana Seva
The Seva will be performed on every Friday from 5.30 AM to 7.00 AM to Moolavarlu. Two persons will be allowed to participate in the said seva on purchase of each ticket at Rs.10,000/-. Grihastas will be allowed to participate in the procession inside the Temple with one silk saree and milk vessel during procession. After procession the grihastas will be allowed to sit infront of Goddess to participate in Abhisekam and after conduct of Abhisekam Grihastas will be allowed for Darshan of Goddess.

Abhishekam
Abhishekam seva will be performed to Moolavarlu on every Friday from 5.30 AM to 7.00 AM. All the Grihastas will be allowed to sit in front of Goddess after the Vastram ticket grihastas. After completion of Abhishekam all the grihastas will be allowed for darshan.
The Cost of ticket is Rs.500/- per head.

Lakshmi Puja
The seva will be performed to Utsava Murthies at Sri Krishnaswamy Mukka Mandapam on every Friday from 9.30 AM to 10.00 AM. Asthotharam will be recite by the Archakas and one Archaka will offer Kumkum to Goddess during this seva. After completion of the seva all the grihastas will be allowed for Darshan of Goddess.
The cost of ticket is Rs.100/- per head.

Pushpanjali Seva
The Seva will be performed on every Saturday from 7.00 AM to 7.30 AM to Moolavarlu. Samavedan will be recite by TTD Vedaparayanamdar and Archakas will offer lotus flowers during the seva. After the seva all the grihastas will be allowed for Darshan of Goddess.
The cost of ticket is Rs.300/- per head.

Astothara Satakalasabhishekam
The seva will be performed to Utsava Murties in front of Moolavarlu on 1st Wednesday of every month. Abhisekam will be performed with 108 Silver Kalasam & Theerthams. All the grihastas will be seated at Ghantamandapam in Sri PAT. After the seva all the grihastas will be allowed for Darshan of Goddess.
The cost of ticket is Rs.1000/- per head.

Important Festivals

Sri Padmavathi Ammavari Temple:
01. Navarathri Festival(Dasara)
02. Kartheeka Brahmotsavam
03. Float festaival
04. Vasanthotsavam
05. Rathasapthami
